'''Berserker rifles''' were a type of kinetic ranged [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] mostly used by the elite [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|Imperial Special Tactical Forces]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The berserker [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] was a kinetic ranged [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] that fired [[Slug|solid projectiles]]. The weapon was composed of various materials, including units of ferrous metal and [[Iron/Legends|iron]]. It also comprised of a number of different components, including a berserker rifle stabilization component and advanced projectile feed mechanisms.<ref name="AED" /> The weapon resembled another rifle called the [[Nullifier X]]. Although similar in appearance, the Nullifier X was an energy-based [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] rather than a slugthrower.<ref name="ROTW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

==History==
The weapon saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], where it mostly saw use by the Empire's elite [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|Imperial Special Tactical Forces]]. However, schematics of the weapon were also available to independent [[weaponsmith]]s and [[Merchant/Legends|munitions traders]]. These schematics were often stored in containers aboard various [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] belonging to the Empire, Rebellion, and the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="AED" /> A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] individual was at one point armed with a berserker rifle.<ref name="SOC">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Berserker Rifle}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Berserker_rifle.jpg|200px|thumb|A Rodian wielding a berserker rifle]]
The [[W:c:swg:Berserker Rifle|berserker rifle]] was included as a [[W:c:swg:Rifle|rifle]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The [[W:c:swg:Weapon|weapon]] was added to the game during the [[W:c:swg:Publish 7|Publish 7]] [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 13 April 04|update]] on [[April 13]], [[2004]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="PublishArchive">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64187&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2004}}</ref> Following this update, players who embarked on the [[W:c:swg:Guide to the Corellian Corvette|Corellian corvette]] [[W:c:swg:Instanced dungeon|instanced dungeon]] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] could find [[W:c:swg:Munition schematic|schematics]] of the weapon inside containers aboard the [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]]. By using these schematics, the weapon could be [[W:c:swg:Crafting|crafted]] by [[W:c:swg:Weaponsmith (pre NGE)|weaponsmiths]].<ref name="AED" /> Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], weaponsmiths were removed,<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> however the weapon could still be constructed by players of the newly created [[W:c:swg:Trader (Munitions)|munitions trader]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]]. The weapon could be constructed using a number of different [[W:c:swg:Ranged weapon component|components]] and [[W:c:swg:Resource|resources]], including [[W:c:swg:Iron|iron]], [[W:c:swg:Ferrous Metal|ferrous metal]], and [[W:c:swg:Metal|metal]].<ref name="AED" />

A couple [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']] reference guides feature the berserker rifle, including ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide]]''<ref name="Total">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> and ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' (2005).<ref name="Complete">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> The 2005 [[W:c:swg:Expansion|expansion]] [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] included a [[W:c:swg:Nullifer X|Nullifer X]] blaster rifle which used the same graphical appearance as the berserker rifle.<ref name="ROTW" /> In the ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'' expansion for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' released on [[December 16]], [[2008]], the berserker rifle was introduced as a game [[W:c:swg:Card list|card]]. The artwork for the berserker rifle illustration was completed by [[Slawomir Maniak]]. The card presented a rather different rendition of the rifle<ref name="SOC" /> as opposed to its more sleek appearance in ''Star Wars Galaxies''.<ref name="AED" /> Slawomir's Maniak's artwork for the berserker rifle was included in the ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'' ([[2014]]) sourcebook.<ref name="Fortune">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> Capitalization of the weapon's name was somewhat inconsistent between sources. ''The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide'' and ''The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide'' fully capitalize the weapon as a Berserker Rifle,<ref name="Total" /><ref name="Complete" /> as did its card for [[W:c:swg:Squadrons Over Corellia|''Squadrons Over Corellia'']].<ref name="SOC" /> ''Star Wars Galaxies'' likewise capitalized the name in the weapon's title, but examining the rifle's [[W:c:swg:Schematic|schematic]] revealed a description which read, "A schematic for a berserker rifle."<ref name="AED" />
